summary: All 755 unit tests pass and the audit is clean except one check. I fixed rounding (half away from zero), negative formatting, dialect precedence, rate lookup (6 months back, earlier months only), reversal booking and valuation, per-entry summing, fiscal quarters, tax effective dates, return quarters, the writer, the recurring medians and HTML totals. The remaining audit failure is the 6.2 case that expects EUR 2026-09 to have no rate; that case assumes a 3-month lookback, but docs/conventions.md says 6, so I followed the doc.
